name: Biosafety cabinet
model: Thermo Scientific 1300 Series Class II A2 · catalog 1305
purpose: Represent sterile handling and preparation of neural cultures.
geometryBrief: Sash, work surface, grilles, airflow panel, interior light and accessory outlets.
behaviorBrief: Sash position, workspace state and contamination risk as an educational approximation.
inputs: Cabinet configuration, sash position, workspace occupancy and timestamped handling events
outputs: Session log with sash and workspace state and a labeled qualitative risk flag
acceptance: Replay a synthetic sash excursion across the configured warning boundary. The warning must follow the excursion and retain the affected sample ID. A visual check cannot establish sterility.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB with articulated sash; manual dimensions and photograph-based detail
simulationStatus: Discrete sash-position and sample-occupancy replay; warning intervals verified
integrationStatus: Interactive simulator, replay input and versioned session-log export
related: Illustrated reference sheet and instrument specifications

name: CO2 / tri-gas incubator
purpose: Maintain mammalian cells and organoids in a controlled environment.
geometryBrief: Outer door, glass inner door, shelves, sensor display and sample trays.
behaviorBrief: Time, temperature, gas setpoint and sample state; biological growth runs separately.
inputs: Sample-to-shelf map, chamber configuration and timestamped environmental readings
outputs: Environmental history linked to sample occupancy intervals
acceptance: Replay a recorded door excursion and place two virtual samples on different schedules. Only samples present during the excursion receive that interval in their exposure history.
geometryStatus: Physical-scale GLB checked against manual dimensions and photographs; internal offsets inferred
simulationStatus: Published chamber CO₂ and temperature replays, verified occupancy clipping and illustrative exchange model
integrationStatus: Logger and sample import, JSON / CSV exposure exports and sample transfer with station 07-01

name: Routine inverted microscope
model: Nikon ECLIPSE Ts2-FL · DS-Fi3 camera, 0.63× relay
geometryBrief: Inverted objective turret, stage, illumination arm, eyepieces and focus knob.
behaviorBrief: Phase-contrast or fluorescence view from sample geometry or real image data.
inputs: Sample image or geometry, calibrated pixel size, installed objective and imaging mode
outputs: Observation image with field of view, scale bar, sample ID and acquisition metadata
acceptance: Image a stage-micrometer fixture through two calibrated objectives. Recover the same physical spacing at both scales and expose fluorescence only for a configured fluorescence variant.
geometryStatus: Metric stand and camera reconstruction with indexed nosepiece, focus and slide motion
simulationStatus: Calibrated camera ROI, micrometer pitch measurement, phase contrast approximation and single-channel epi-fluorescence
integrationStatus: Interactive instrument with calibrated raster import, PNG and acquisition JSON export, and sample handoff to 07-02

name: Time-lapse live cell imager
purpose: Observe cultures over long time periods.
geometryBrief: Incubator-compatible imaging unit, slide/plate holder and camera/controller.
behaviorBrief: Time-lapse frames, growth tracking and viability annotation; label generated versus measured data.
inputs: Timestamped image sequence, field ID, spatial calibration and tracking annotations
outputs: Time-lapse observation with track coordinates, gaps and source provenance
acceptance: Track a synthetic object translating by a known distance at irregular frame intervals. Recover physical velocity from timestamps and retain a missing-frame gap.

name: Live cell imager
purpose: Longitudinal monitoring of cell growth and morphology.
geometryBrief: Incubator-resident imaging module, plate carriers and workstation.
behaviorBrief: Multiwell snapshots and time courses; stream or precompute images.
inputs: Plate map, well and field IDs, timestamped image series and segmentation masks
outputs: Per-well confluence and morphology time courses with coverage and missing-data flags
acceptance: Replay two wells with independent known foreground-area ramps. Each trace must recover its own occupied fraction and a skipped well must display a missing value.

name: Refrigerated centrifuge
geometryBrief: Lid, rotor, buckets, balance tubes, control panel and interlock.
behaviorBrief: Rotor selection, simulated balance state and fraction bookkeeping.
inputs: Rotor layout, tube masses, parent sample IDs and recorded fraction yields
outputs: Run-state record and labeled daughter fractions with parentage and unrecovered material
acceptance: Place equal masses opposite each other in a symmetric rotor, then remove one. The balance flag must change, and replayed fraction totals plus recorded loss must equal the parent quantity.

name: Cell counter
purpose: Estimate viable cell count and density.
geometryBrief: Compact touchscreen, slide slot and counting slide.
behaviorBrief: Count distributions with sampling uncertainty, not a perfect census.
inputs: Counting-slide image, calibrated observation volume and class-labeled reference masks
outputs: Count and concentration measurements with class counts and sampling uncertainty
acceptance: Use an annotated image with known class counts and volume. Recover the counts in an ideal fixture and scale concentration inversely when the specified sampled volume doubles.
geometryStatus: Source-grounded sealed Countess 3 FL metric exterior
simulationStatus: Dormant cabinet and separate geometric badge-count diagrams
integrationStatus: Standalone browser station; no specimen or equipment connection

name: Tissue dissociator
model: Miltenyi gentleMACS Octo Dissociator with heaters
purpose: Represent dissociation of tissue into cell populations.
geometryBrief: Multiple tube stations, heater modules and touch controls.
behaviorBrief: Cell yield and viability parameters, abstract workflow only.
inputs: Tissue record, recorded yield summary, viability labels and parent batch ID
outputs: Derived suspension record carrying source linkage and reported yield uncertainty
acceptance: Replay an annotated benchmark with known viable, nonviable and unclassified counts. Preserve the reported totals and unclassified category, including missing measurements.

name: Electroporation
purpose: Represent cellular delivery of experimental material.
geometryBrief: Stacked modules, cuvette/strip drawer and screen.
behaviorBrief: Record experimental condition; no protocol or genetic engineering recipe supplied.
inputs: Sample ID, opaque condition identifier and externally recorded assay outcomes
outputs: Condition event and linked outcome observations with provenance
acceptance: Replay two labeled conditions, one lacking an outcome. Each must retain its supplied observations and the missing outcome must remain unknown.

name: Flow cytometer / sorter
purpose: Analyze and isolate defined cell populations.
geometryBrief: Enclosure, sample loading arm, fluidic tanks, collection area and computer.
behaviorBrief: Gating, event counts and population selection based on supplied distributions.
inputs: Event table, channel units, gate polygons and parent population ID
outputs: Event membership, counts and virtual daughter-population records
acceptance: Apply a rectangular gate to a hand-labeled point cloud containing boundary points. Match expected event IDs under the documented boundary rule and deduplicate overlapping gates in the union.

name: Plate reader
purpose: Quantify viability or fluorescence assays in microplates.
geometryBrief: Plate drawer, enclosure, optical path schematic and workstation.
inputs: Plate map, blank wells, reference intensities and calibration curve
outputs: Per-well absorbance or fluorescence record with blank correction and uncertainty
acceptance: Use a synthetic dilution series in the calibration range with a known blank offset. Recover the supplied slope and map each result back to its original well.

name: PCR instrument
purpose: Analyze gene-expression assay data when available.
geometryBrief: Instrument block, heated lid and screen.
behaviorBrief: Reference amplification curves and Cq analysis; not a molecular protocol trainer.
inputs: Archived fluorescence-versus-cycle curves, baseline convention, threshold and well IDs
outputs: Analysis record with per-well Cq, curve provenance and undetermined flags
acceptance: Supply a curve crossing the threshold midway between cycles and a flat control below threshold. Linear interpolation must recover the half-cycle value and mark the control undetermined.

name: Cryogenic cell storage
purpose: Preserve archived sample IDs and batches.
geometryBrief: Dewar, lid, racks, cryovials and controller.
behaviorBrief: Inventory, temperature state and sample retrieval; no physical cryogenic procedures.
inputs: Archive inventory, unique vial and batch IDs, rack positions and logged temperature
outputs: Storage or retrieval event with address, time and environmental history
acceptance: Store two labeled vials, retrieve one and replay that event. Only its location should change and each vial must retain its original batch identity.

name: Ultra-low freezer
model: Thermo Scientific TSX series (exact cabinet pending)
purpose: Store frozen biological samples and reagents.
geometryBrief: Insulated door, inner compartments, racks, handles and display.
behaviorBrief: Sample registry and temperature alarm state.
inputs: Rack occupancy, sample IDs, compartment temperature trace and alarm rule
outputs: Temperature alarm intervals and affected inventory records
acceptance: Replay a trace with one threshold excursion across a known inventory change. Flag the excursion and associate only the samples present during its interval.

name: Perfusion bioreactor
model: Synthecon rotary cell culture system (vessel variant pending)
purpose: Maintain 3D constructs under controlled culture conditions.
geometryBrief: Rotating vessel, motor mount, controller and removable sample chamber.
behaviorBrief: Rotation/flow proxy, nutrient transport model and time course.
inputs: Vessel configuration, construct ID, recorded rotation or flow, and tracer boundary conditions
outputs: Transport time course with vessel-frame coordinates and model assumptions
acceptance: For a declared closed-vessel conservative tracer fixture, require constant total tracer mass under rotation. Compare spatial redistribution separately with a measured tracer series for the chosen vessel.
